name: Geography
description: India and world physical geography for competitive exams.

questions.question: What is the southernmost point of India?
questions.explanation: Indira Point on Great Nicobar Island (6°45'N) is India's southernmost point; Kanyakumari is the southernmost tip of the mainland.

questions.question: The Indian Standard Time meridian (82°30'E) passes through which town in Uttar Pradesh?
questions.explanation: IST is set on the 82°30'E meridian passing near Mirzapur — 5 hours 30 minutes ahead of GMT.

questions.question: Which is the largest state of India by area?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan (~3.42 lakh km²) is the largest state; Madhya Pradesh is second.

questions.question: Which is the most populous state of India?
questions.explanation: Uttar Pradesh is India's most populous state; if it were a country it would rank among the world's ten largest by population.

questions.question: The Palakkad (Palghat) Gap connects which two states through the Western Ghats?
questions.explanation: The Palakkad Gap (~30–40 km wide) is the lowest pass through the Western Ghats, linking Kerala with Tamil Nadu and channelling the southwest monsoon.

questions.question: Which is the highest peak of the Eastern Ghats?
questions.explanation: Jindhagada Peak (~1,690 m) in Andhra Pradesh is the highest point of the Eastern Ghats; Anamudi is the Western Ghats' (and South India's) highest.

questions.question: The Narmada and Tapi rivers flow westward through rift valleys into which water body?
questions.explanation: Unlike most peninsular rivers, the Narmada and Tapi flow west through rift valleys and drain into the Arabian Sea.

questions.question: The Hirakud Dam, one of the world's longest earthen dams, is built across which river?
questions.explanation: The Hirakud Dam (Odisha, 1957) spans the Mahanadi — the first major multipurpose river valley project of independent India.

questions.question: Chilika Lake, Asia's largest brackish-water lagoon, is located in which state?
questions.explanation: Chilika in Odisha is Asia's largest coastal lagoon and India's first Ramsar site (1981); it hosts the Irrawaddy dolphin.

questions.question: The Sundarbans — the world's largest mangrove forest and delta — is formed by which rivers?
questions.explanation: The Sundarbans delta is formed by the Ganga–Brahmaputra–Meghna system; it is home to the Royal Bengal Tiger and is a UNESCO site.

questions.question: The word 'monsoon' is derived from the Arabic word 'mausim', which means what?
questions.explanation: 'Mausim' means season — referring to the seasonal reversal of winds that brings rain to the Indian subcontinent.

questions.question: Black (regur) soil, ideal for cotton, is formed from the weathering of which rock type?
questions.explanation: Black soil derives from weathered basalt of the Deccan Traps; it retains moisture and is rich in lime, iron and magnesia.

questions.question: Laterite soils are formed mainly by which process in high-rainfall, high-temperature regions?
questions.explanation: Heavy rain leaches silica from the soil, leaving iron and aluminium oxides — hence 'laterite' (from Latin 'later', brick).

questions.question: K2 (Godwin-Austen), the world's second-highest peak, lies in which range?
questions.explanation: K2 (8,611 m) lies in the Karakoram range in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir — India's highest peak wholly in its territory is Kangchenjunga.

questions.question: The Siachen Glacier, the world's highest battlefield, is located in which range?
questions.explanation: The Siachen Glacier (~76 km) lies in the eastern Karakoram in Ladakh, at altitudes above 5,400 m.

questions.question: Barren Island, India's only confirmed active volcano, is located in which archipelago?
questions.explanation: Barren Island in the Andaman Sea erupted most recently in 2017–2021; it is part of the Andaman & Nicobar Islands.

questions.question: Which is the highest peak located entirely within India?
questions.explanation: Kangchenjunga (8,586 m) on the Sikkim–Nepal border is the highest peak lying wholly within India and the world's third highest.

questions.question: India is separated from Sri Lanka by which water body?
options: Palk Strait and Gulf of Mannar
questions.explanation: The Palk Strait and the Gulf of Mannar separate India from Sri Lanka; Adam's Bridge (Ram Setu) lies between them.

questions.question: India shares its longest international land border with which country?
questions.explanation: The India–Bangladesh border (~4,096 km, including enclave adjustments) is India's longest — and among the world's longest.

questions.question: Which is India's oldest national park, established in 1936 as Hailey National Park?
questions.explanation: Jim Corbett National Park (Uttarakhand) was established in 1936, originally named after Governor Hailey; Project Tiger was launched here in 1973.
